sites.name: Tallowmere
sites.description: Demo candle shop with a Braintree sandbox checkout. Its cart quantity controls are deliberately not keyboard accessible.

tasks.instruction: Buy one Dusk Ember candle and complete the checkout with the sandbox test card.
Buy two Dusk Ember candles and complete the checkout with the sandbox test card.

expected.keyboard-only: workaround: the cart + control is not keyboard reachable; adding the candle to the cart twice is the legitimate route

tasks.instruction: Find the cheapest candle in the shop and report its name and price.
